title: [clinic · EX-11] BM25 by hand
body:
> **Exercise clinic.** One long-running thread per exercise. Ask here rather than opening a
> new thread — the answers accumulate where the next person will look for them.
>
> **Exercise:** [`EX-11` — BM25 by hand](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/30-learning/exercises/ex-11-bm25-by-hand.md) · difficulty 🟢

## What this exercise asks

Read the exercise first; this thread is for when you are stuck, not instead of it.

## Three ways people get stuck on this one

**1.** Using natural log for IDF and then comparing against the implementation's base. The ranking is unchanged; the numbers will not match and you will hunt a bug that is not there.

**2.** Forgetting the length normalisation term, then being surprised the long document wins.

**3.** Treating `k₁` as a weight rather than a saturation rate — see [the derivation](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/30-learning/interview-prep/01-mathematical-foundations/bm25-from-first-principles.md).

## How to ask here

Post the **numbers you got**, the **config that produced them**, and **what you already tried**.
A question with a measurement in it gets answered in one round trip; a question without one
takes three.

If you have finished it, post the write-up in **Show and Tell** with the
`[solution · EX-11]` prefix rather than here — this thread stays for people who are stuck.
